input.goal: Create index.html from scratch: full-screen HTML5 Canvas Boids flocking simulation (separation, alignment, cohesion), starting paused, with a glassmorphism HUD and controls.
constraints: Single self-contained file index.html; inline CSS and JS only; zero external dependencies (no CDN, no fonts, no imports).
Zero JavaScript errors or console errors.
A <canvas id="canvas"> fills the full window (100vw x 100vh, resizes on window resize), body margin 0, overflow hidden, background color #070b14 (canvas cleared with #070b14 each frame).

Boids implement separation, alignment and cohesion steering with max speed, and wrap around screen edges. Draw each boid as a bright filled triangle pointing in its velocity direction (e.g. color #7dd3fc) so it is clearly visible.
Initial state: at least 40 boids (use 60) at random positions; simulation starts PAUSED, but the initial frame is drawn so boids are visible immediately.

Expose window.app = { boids: Array, running: boolean, speed: number, fps: number, frame: number, step(): void, reset(): void, togglePlay(): void, addBoid(x, y): void }. app.running is false at load. app.frame increments by 1 for each simulation update (step).
Render loop uses requestAnimationFrame always (to compute FPS and redraw); simulation only updates when running. Update movement scaled by app.speed.

HUD panel id="hud" with glassmorphism style: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius 16px, positioned fixed top-left, light text color.
HUD shows: element id="fps" with FPS number, element id="count" with the number of boids (exactly app.boids.length as text), element id="speedValue" showing current speed with one decimal like 1.0.
Button id="playBtn": text is exactly "Play" when paused and "Pause" when running; clicking calls togglePlay.
Button id="stepBtn" with text "Step": advances simulation by exactly one update (app.frame += 1) while paused.
Button id="resetBtn" with text "Reset": regenerates 60 random boids, sets app.frame = 0, sets paused (running=false, playBtn text Play), redraws.
Slider <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.5" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">; on input sets app.speed to parseFloat(value) and updates #speedValue.

Clicking on the canvas (mousedown/click on canvas only, not on HUD) adds a new boid at the click coordinates with random velocity; #count updates immediately and the canvas is redrawn even when paused.
HUD controls must be above the canvas (z-index) and clicks on the HUD must not add boids.
verify_commands: tandem:ui_test {"steps":[{"wait":500},{"exists":"canvas#canvas"},{"exists":"#hud"},{"text":"#playBtn","match":"^\\s*Play\\s*$"},{"js":"window.app && window.app.running===false && window.app.boids.length>=40"},{"js":"document.getElementById('count').textContent.trim()===String(app.boids.length)"},{"js":"getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor==='rgb(7, 11, 20)' || getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).backgroundColor==='rgb(7, 11, 20)'"},{"js":"(()=>{const c=document.getElementById('canvas');return c.width>=window.innerWidth-2 && c.height>=window.innerHeight-2})()"},{"js":"(()=>{const s=document.getElementById('speed');return s.type==='range'&&parseFloat(s.min)===0.5&&parseFloat(s.max)===3})()"},{"js":"/blur/.test(getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('hud')).backdropFilter||getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('hud')).webkitBackdropFilter||'')"},{"expect":"static"},{"js":"window.__f0=app.frame; true"},{"click":"#stepBtn"},{"wait":100},{"js":"app.frame===window.__f0+1 && app.running===false"},{"js":"window.__n=app.boids.length; true"},{"click":"canvas#canvas"},{"wait":100},{"js":"app.boids.length===window.__n+1 && document.getElementById('count').textContent.trim()===String(app.boids.length)"},{"js":"(()=>{const s=document.getElementById('speed');s.value='2.5';s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return Math.abs(app.speed-2.5)<1e-9 && /2\\.5/.test(document.getElementById('speedValue').textContent)})()"},{"click":"#playBtn"},{"wait":500},{"text":"#playBtn","match":"^\\s*Pause\\s*$"},{"js":"app.running===true && app.frame>window.__f0+5"},{"expect":"moving"},{"js":"parseFloat(document.getElementById('fps').textContent.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,''))>0"},{"click":"#resetBtn"},{"wait":200},{"js":"app.running===false && app.frame===0 && app.boids.length>=40"},{"text":"#playBtn","match":"^\\s*Play\\s*$"}]}
